balanced80_s1000_evidence.comparison_boundary: C58 was trained for 10000 steps; s1000 C71 is a mechanism diagnostic only and cannot establish inferiority or promotion.

numerical_terminal_evidence.boundary: The original run stopped before checkpointing step9919 because cosine LR 2.098e-8 produced a zero BF16 parameter update and tripped the per-step update assertion. The immutable s9000 parent was replayed over the identical 918 rows-per-rank schedule and stopped at the last observed nonzero-update step. This is not represented as s10000.

decision.rationale: The strict s9918 numerical endpoint and exact independent restore pass. Evaluate the fixed balanced80 protocol at s9918; do not call the endpoint s10000 and do not change the optimizer floor after inspecting the late trajectory. Closed-loop remains gated by the terminal held-out result.
